### Fixed
- **Every OCIRepository the chart renders selects the Helm chart layer: `layerSelector: {mediaType: application/vnd.cncf.helm.chart.content.v1.tar+gzip, operation: copy}`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#649). Without a selector, source-controller extracts the artifact's first layer. A signed chart carries its provenance as a second layer, and `helm push` orders the two by digest, so on about every other signed release the provenance comes first. The upstream CloudNativePG chart 0.29.1 is such a release: with `components.cloudnative-pg` on, the OCIRepository failed with `requires gzip-compressed body: gzip: invalid header`, stayed on 0.29.0 and read Ready=False. The artifact revision (`<tag>@<manifest digest>`) is unchanged, and helm-controller derives the chart version from it, so the rollout upgrades no release. `make verify-components-charts` now requires the selector on every rendered OCIRepository and resolves the selected layer in each resolved artifact, at the range and at the BOM pin. `helm pull` finds the chart by media type wherever it sits, so the check could not see this failure before. No range or source changes.
